properties.name: reflow2 has kept the original reflow's founding spirit and principles, and has inherited exactly one of reflow's drifts — the knife sharpening the knife — plus two places it sits behind reflow's intent
properties.statement:
Review of all of /home/ajs7/project/reflow (v3.0→v4.1.2, 2025-10-16→2025-12-06) against reflow2's design, 2026-09-13, at Anthony's request; full quote trail in docs/reflow-spirit-review-2026-09-13.md.

WHAT REFLOW WAS FOR, in its own words: the axiom "Every system can be modeled as nodes (black boxes with functions) connected by edges (interfaces/interactions)" (definitions/core_abstraction.json); the founding diagnosis "Context Overload … Repository Clutter … Instruction Non-Adherence" (docs/archive/instructions/INDEX.md, 2025-10-19); the product is the list of what is MISSING (six gap types); function before structure; "Prevent architecture drift" (workflow_master.json); the human chooses rigid or flexible; compute structure and hand meaning back; "Machine-readable JSON is insufficient for stakeholder communication and validation"; never delete history; design the operational world upfront. Its mission page was retrofitted on 2025-10-25 by reflow running its own setup on itself.

WHERE REFLOW ITSELF DRIFTED (its own record): three self-analysis workflows (97/98/99; 99 at 55 KB, larger than the development workflow) whose subject became reflow's own control structures; tools 24→16 once ("Cognitive Overload"), then 49+; CLAUDE.md 41 KB of stacked release notes; "VALIDATION PASSED" on a graph with zero edges; 39 tools and 38 step files referenced but absent; tool_readiness_index validated_tools: 0, tested_tools: 0; crossed its own handoff boundary into hatchling/ruff/pytest choices and a 27,741-line C++→Python port; broke its own "NEVER generate reports — exceptions: NONE" rule within six days; restructuring declared COMPLETE while transferring 40% of context management and 15% of versioning; and its own final audit: "LLMs optimize for 'getting to the answer' not 'following the process'" — unsolved.

REFLOW2 KEPT FAITH: the axiom (req:recursive-black-box-decomposition, with its shortfall measured); function before structure (genesis stops at capabilities; the maturity ladder); the gap as product plus report-dont-judge and no fabricated repairs; never PASS over emptiness (modularity "not measurable", unknown contributor refused, every zero says which zero) — the exact repair for reflow's worst instrument failure; mechanised drift prevention (checksums, reconcile, two-sided acceptance, the gate on every commit); the owner's word governs intent (ENFORCED); history never overwritten; instructions served from the binary so CLAUDE.md is a pointer; referenced ⇒ exists. Dropped from reflow in July on the record and confirmed right by reflow's own admissions: the framework registry, context as a static edge weight, drift as one similarity scalar.

REFLOW2 INHERITED REFLOW'S DRIFT, measured: self-host is 7,472 of 9,335 recorded tool calls (80%), 700 Decisions and 4,380 nodes about itself, rule:reflow2-is-built-for-other-projects-not-for-itself restated twice; 181 served tools, 40 never called (dec:bl-155), one retirement ever; 249 of 254 verifications have no executable form and 42 never ran (reflow's tested_tools: 0 shape); enforcement stacked on the unsolved skill-use problem (req:skill-use-survives-a-long-session accepted, not built); neutral nouns with software-shaped delivery (model/drawing/diagram artifact types used 0 times; Environment layer designed, unbuilt); and 106 of 108 Components read `planned` on a shipped system (fact:106-of-108-components-read-planned-on-a-shipped-system).

BEHIND REFLOW'S INTENT: (1) the mandatory human-readable view — reflow made BPMN/UML BLOCKING; reflow2's human view is prose and graph_report_markdown, and SV-1/SV-4 rendering (epoch:the-systems-views-are-rendered-from-the-graph) is planned, unbuilt, and now unblocked by the seam work; (2) three reflow lifecycle ideas read 2026-07-28 and still proposed: req:intent-is-reinjected (payload arrived 2026-09-13 as the design reference), req:build-loop-is-bounded (reflow's iteration budget), req:scenarios-are-modelled (reflow's USER_SCENARIOS as validation targets).

VERDICT: faithful in spirit and principle; drifted in the one way reflow did — toward itself. NOT VERIFIED: reflow's tools were not re-run; its test-system claims are read from its own reports, which round up (a "3/3 PASS" that checks four structural booleans and no physics; a "🟢 VALIDATION SUCCESSFUL" whose inference never ran). Nothing adopted or reimplemented, on Anthony's word.
